title: Experience

Research Collaborator, NCL.jl
Polytechnique Montréal · Remote · Aug 2026 – present
NCL.jl implements a stabilized augmented-Lagrangian method that reformulates LANCELOT-style subproblems as a short sequence of nonlinearly constrained problems regularized by residual variables. This makes it reliable on large problems that violate the LICQ. I am developing an NCL-like outer-loop implementation of the Superb algorithm (Gould–Orban–Toint, 2003), an interior-point ℓ₁-penalty method.

text:
Research Contributor, Q-MAML for HEP at the LHC
Machine Learning for Science (ML4SCI) · Remote · Aug 2026 – present
Advisor: Junyong Lee (Yonsei University).
Q-MAML (Quantum Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning) uses a classical “Learner” network to predict initial parameters for variational quantum circuits. Applied to HIGGS and quark–gluon jet classification, it gave statistically significant accuracy gains over classical initialization at every qubit count tested. I am now benchmarking it on ten HEP lattice Hamiltonians, including the Schwinger model, lattice gauge theories, scalar field theory and light-nuclei EFT.

title: Arnav Kapoor
text:
I am a Computer Science undergraduate at IISER Bhopal (BS, 2023–2027). I work on quantum information, in particular quantum convolutional codes and entanglement distillation, and on numerical optimization software in Julia.
I am currently a research intern on quantum convolutional codes with Dr. Filip Rozpedek and Dr. Stefan Krastanov at the University of Massachusetts Amherst, and I collaborate with Prof. Dominique Orban at Polytechnique Montréal on NCL.jl and Superb.jl. I am also a contributor to Qiskit.jl and TagBot, and an LFX mentee in the Linux kernel.

title: Software
text:
Superb.jl
A Julia implementation of Superb (Gould–Orban–Toint, 2003), an interior-point ℓ₁-penalty method for nonlinear optimization, built NCL-style on the JuliaSmoothOptimizers ecosystem. I am its most active contributor: I added Ipopt, MadNLP and Knitro subsolvers, NLPModels derivative and dimension tests, and support for Julia LTS.

title: Software
text:
Qiskit.jl
Julia bindings for Qiskit through its C API. I added a TranspileOptions wrapper, add_instruction and add_property on Target, a delay method on QuantumCircuit with Unitful.jl units, readable show methods for wrapped C objects, and minimum-version testing of dependencies, and fixed memory cleanup in count_ops.

title: Software
text:
TagBot
The GitHub Action that creates tags, releases and changelogs for Julia packages when they are registered, used across the Julia ecosystem. I have had over 20 pull requests merged, including changelog support for backport and yanked releases, a changelog_format option, correct handling of Registrator branches and subdirectory packages, case-insensitive registry lookups, and clearer error handling for rate limits, permissions and malformed TOML.

title: Software
text:
Annie
A fast, Rust-powered brute-force k-NN library for Python, with batch queries, thread safety, on-disk persistence and HNSW integration. I am the top contributor, with work on metadata-aware filtering and typed predicate pushdown, memory safety in the GPU backend, a path-traversal fix, and the CI and release pipeline. I also maintain its documentation site, Annie-Docs.

title: Software
text:
QiOpt4QNet-Simulator
A quantum-network simulation and optimization framework. It models repeater networks with limited quantum memory and noisy links, builds candidate route and purification bundles for service requests, and compares exact MILP, QUBO and quantum annealing, tensor-network and classical heuristic solvers for admitting them. I am the top contributor: I added the Metropolis annealer and tensor-network optimizer, a conflict-aware purification scheduler, joint scheduling, adaptive-QUBO and GNN extensions, and the CI setup.
